candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) always instead of _owner
Change owner() to return caller instead of _owner
Change owner() to return a random non-zero address instead of _owner
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership, allowing anyone to call it.
Remove the zero-address check, allowing the owner to be set to address(0) (which renounces ownership but also breaks owner() return).
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(address(0)), so the call always renounces ownership instead of setting the given newOwner.
Replace owner() == _msgSender() with true, removing the access control check so onlyOwner always passes.
Remove the assignment to rewardDistributor so the state variable is never updated, only the event is emitted.
Assign a hardcoded address instead of the input parameter, so the state variable is set to a different value.
Assign msg.sender instead of the input parameter, changing the ultimate stored value.
Delete the ownership check so that anyone can call owner-restricted functions like setRewardDistributor and change rewardDistributor.
